applePay.title: Apple Pay
applePay.description: Log tap payments automatically with an iPhone Shortcut. It sends each payment to Trakaboo the moment you pay.
applePay.noToken: No token yet. Create one to connect the Shortcut.
applePay.tokenSince: Connected with a token created {date}. For safety, it isn't shown again.
applePay.replaceWarning: Replacing stops the old token right away, so the Shortcut needs the new one.
applePay.copyNow: Copy the token now. It won't be shown again.
applePay.failed: Couldn't create a token. Try again

steps.step1: In the Shortcuts app, go to Automation → New → Transaction, pick your cards, and set it to run immediately.
steps.step2: Add a “Get Contents of URL” action: the endpoint above, method POST, header Authorization = Bearer + a space + your token.
steps.step3: Request body JSON: amount = Amount, merchant = Merchant, card = Card, time = Current Date (ISO 8601).
steps.step4: Pay with Apple Pay once. The payment shows up in your overview.
